title: Amels Unveils Record-Breaking Project Tanzanite
description: Amels redefines yacht-building with Project Tanzanite, a record-breaking 120m yacht featuring innovative design and technology in the Netherlands.
html:
Amels has set a new benchmark in the Dutch yacht-building industry with the launch of Project Tanzanite, a 120-meter motor yacht that now holds the distinction of being the largest ever constructed in the Netherlands. This monumental project is currently under development at Damen Yachting’s facility in Vlissingen, where over 1,000 skilled craftspeople are dedicated to its completion. Scheduled for delivery in 2026, Project Tanzanite represents a significant leap from Amels’ previous flagship, the 89-meter Here Comes The Sun, extending the fleet’s capabilities by an impressive 31 meters.

The yacht’s journey began at Damen Yachting’s hull-building site in Galati, Romania, before proceeding to the Netherlands. The launch in May 2023 was marked by a ceremony attended by local schoolchildren, highlighting the community’s involvement in this significant event. Jeroen Waalewijn, Amels project manager, expressed the profound impact of witnessing the hull’s launch, attributing it to the collective effort of the project team. This event highlights the collaborative spirit and meticulous planning that have characterized the development of Project Tanzanite.

Espen Øino Designs Striking Exterior for Tanzanite

The exterior design of Project Tanzanite is the work of renowned designer Espen Øino, who has collaborated with Amels on several projects over the past two years. Øino’s expertise is evident in the yacht’s sleek lines and innovative design elements, which are consistent with the yard’s reputation for excellence. His previous projects with Amels include the Amels 60, Amels 80, and the 77.8-meter custom yacht Energy, each showcasing his distinctive style and attention to detail.

Inside, the yacht features interiors crafted by Zuretti Design, a studio based in Nice. The design embraces a warm and contemporary aesthetic, utilizing a palette of cream and brown tones. Curved furniture and statement walls in wood and marble add to the sophisticated ambiance, creating a harmonious environment that complements the yacht’s exterior elegance. The collaboration between Øino and Zuretti Design ensures that Project Tanzanite offers a cohesive and refined experience for its future occupants.

Advanced Technology Powers Project Tanzanite

Project Tanzanite is equipped with cutting-edge technology that sets it apart in terms of performance and efficiency. The yacht features diesel-electric engines paired with Azipod electric propulsion, a combination that enhances operational efficiency while minimizing noise and vibration. This technological advancement ensures that Project Tanzanite operates with some of the lowest noise levels ever recorded for a yacht of its size, reflecting Amels’ commitment to innovation and environmental responsibility.

In addition to its propulsion system, Project Tanzanite incorporates the latest in design and engineering to optimize performance and comfort. As part of Amels’ broader portfolio, which includes 10 superyacht projects currently on order or under construction, Project Tanzanite exemplifies the yard’s dedication to pushing the boundaries of yacht design and construction. Among these projects are five units from the popular Amels 80 series, further demonstrating the yard’s capacity to deliver exceptional vessels tailored to client specifications.

Project Tanzanite represents a significant milestone for Amels and the Dutch yacht-building industry. With its record-breaking size, innovative design, and advanced technology, the yacht sets a new standard for excellence. As the project progresses toward its 2026 delivery, it stands as a testament to the skill and dedication of the team at Damen Yachting and their collaborators.
